items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: the author of the article was writing about such a great band as Thamon Hayes and you were on it with Booker and the Walders

ctx.x: Well Baby, you and Crook might elaborate on this article I read in the Mississippi Rag that the banner headline said, "The Band that FAME Eluded" and the author of the article was writing about such a great band as Thamon Hayes and you were on it with Booker and the Walders but somehow or other fame eluded that band. Now why Baby?
